name: Pixel Art Workflow
description: From Krita to Unity without blurry sprites: canvas sizes, a palette, layers as sprites, pixels per unit and the Pixel Perfect Camera.
author: Gamedev Dashboard

goals.title: Set up the pipeline
steps: Link the Krita folder and turn on auto import
Turn on Pixel art and set pixels per unit on the Unity page
Add a Pixel Perfect Camera to the main camera

goals.title: Palette and style
steps: Draw the player at the chosen size
Check it in Unity at 1x and 3x zoom

goals.title: Tileset
steps: Slice the tileset in the Sprite Editor

pages.title: Style guide
pages.markdown:
## Sizes
- Tiles: 16 x 16 px
- Player: 16 x 24 px
- Pixels per unit: 16

## Rules
- Only colors from the palette
- No anti-aliasing on the outline
- Light comes from the top left

## Unity import
- Filter mode: Point
- Compression: None
- The Unity plugin sets both when Pixel art is on
